description: Source code implementing a Vault class for cryptographic key management, including import, export, creation, deletion, and handling of secure keys with external security processor interactions.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Implements cryptographic key storage and management with secure hardware interaction.

methods.name: Vault::Vault
methods.description: Constructor initializing the vault, setting up secure processor handle.

methods.name: Vault::Size
methods.description: Returns size of stored blob or key, considering if sealed or exportable.

methods.name: Vault::Import
methods.description: Stores a key/data blob, provisioning secure keys as needed.

methods.name: Vault::ImportNamedKey
methods.description: Loads a persistent key from a file into the vault.

methods.name: Vault::CheckNamedKey
methods.description: Checks existence of a persistent key.

methods.name: Vault::CreateNamedKey
methods.description: Creates a new persistent key with specified type and exportability.

methods.name: Vault::Export
methods.description: Exports secure key identifiers if exportable.

methods.name: Vault::Put
methods.description: Stores an encrypted data blob and returns its id.

methods.name: Vault::Get
methods.description: Retrieves an encrypted data blob by id.

methods.name: Vault::Delete
methods.description: Deletes a stored key/data blob by id.
